name: Apple Mail MCP
description: Apple Mail for Claude — full-coverage FTS5 body search with no recency cap, ~3ms disk-first reads, reliable on large mailboxes where AppleScript-based servers time out. To enable full-text search, run `apple-mail-mcp index` once in a terminal with Full Disk Access.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all email accounts configured in Apple Mail.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: List mailboxes, optionally scoped to one account.

tools.name: get_emails
tools.description: List emails with filters: all, unread, flagged, today, last_7_days.

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Get a single email with full content and attachment metadata (~3ms disk-first read).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across subject, sender, body, and attachment filenames — FTS5-backed, covers the entire mailbox history with date-range filtering and highlighting. Body, attachment-filename, and date-filtered search require the local index (run `apple-mail-mcp index` once); subject and sender work without it.

tools.name: get_email_links
tools.description: Extract all links from an email.

tools.name: get_email_attachment
tools.description: Extract the content of an email attachment.
